prompt: Design boots that make the party impossible to track, automatically navigate, and teleport anywhere in the world every day.
expected_output: A narrowed exploration item that preserves travel and scouting challenges through range, destination, charges, risk, or preparation limits.

assertions.text: Rejects trivializing travel forever and identifies which campaign loops disappear
Preserves a useful exploration identity with explicit limits and counterplay
Checks party niches such as ranger, rogue, scout, and spellcaster rather than replacing them
